company_name.description: The presenting company's name as printed in Japanese on the cover, e.g. '任天堂株式会社'

presentation_title.description: The title on the cover slide, e.g. '2027年3月期第2四半期 決算説明資料'

presentation_date.description: The date on the cover slide, as YYYY-MM-DD

reporting_period.description: The period whose actual results are reported, as labelled in the results tables, e.g. 'FY27/Q1-Q2'

consolidated_results.description: The current-period column of the 連結業績（実績） consolidated results table, amounts in 億円 (hundred millions of yen)

net_sales.description: 売上高 for the current period, in 億円, as a number

net_sales_change_percent.description: Year-on-year change in 売上高, in percent, as a signed number

operating_profit.description: 営業利益 for the current period, in 億円, as a number

operating_margin_percent.description: 営業利益率 for the current period, in percent, as a number

ordinary_profit.description: 経常利益 for the current period, in 億円, as a number

net_profit.description: 中間純利益 (profit attributable to owners of parent) for the current period, in 億円, as a number

net_profit_prior_period.description: 中間純利益 for the same period a year earlier, in 億円, as a number

digital_sales.description: From the デジタル売上高 (digital sales) slide
デジタル売上高 for the current period, in 億円, as a number

digital_sales_ratio_percent.description: デジタル売上高比率 for the current period, in percent, as a number

unit_sales.description: Hardware and software sell-in units for the current period, one row per platform and category, from the 主な販売状況 slide

units_10k.description: Units sold in the current period, in 万 (ten thousands), as a number

change_percent.description: Year-on-year change, in percent, as a signed number

full_year_forecast.description: The forecast column (FY27予想) of the 連結業績（予想） slide

net_sales.description: Forecast 売上高, in 億円, as a number

operating_profit.description: Forecast 営業利益, in 億円, as a number

ordinary_profit.description: Forecast 経常利益, in 億円, as a number

net_profit.description: Forecast 当期純利益, in 億円, as a number

annual_dividend_yen.description: Forecast 年間配当 per share, in yen, as a number

usd_jpy_assumption.description: Assumed US dollar exchange rate (前提為替レート), yen per dollar, as a number

million_seller_titles.description: Every first-party title in the 当期ミリオンセラー自社タイトル table

worldwide_units_current_period_10k.description: 全世界合計 for FY27/Q1-Q2, in 万本, as a number
